Nothing in the six views has that silhouette, and the line-up in lineup.png shows the same crowbar-like rod.

The asset has none of them: one plain red shaft with a grey crowbar-style hook at one end (sides.png, first-person.png). The stock is not folding and there is no pump, so the named parts are missing.

The asset is not held where the original sits or held the same way, and the in-hand.png model is also a rod, not a gun's grip.
